description: Declarative rules that assign each Burnley spending row a record_class. Burnley is a district authority publishing three feeds (spend / contracts / purchase_cards) — procurement is the dominant class. contracts → procurement_committed (POs raised; 77% pair with a matching spend record within 90d). spend + purchase_cards → procurement_paid. Burnley has no REDACTED Care-Act rows, no EFT settlement noise, and no accrual ledger exposure at district scale. Internal-transfer candidates (e.g. Burnley Leisure Trust management fee) await explicit FOI-verified status before tagging — conservative default keeps them in procurement_paid.

rules.reason: 4,044 rows. POs raised in the finance system but not yet settled as paid invoices. 77% pair with a spend record within 90 days (find_po_spend_pairs) — those pairs are excluded from duplicate/split detection to avoid double-counting the same transaction across feeds. Unpaired contracts (e.g. CRF grant PORD085086 to Planet Pizza, £98,498, 22 Mar 2022, never drew down) may be lapsed POs.
Default for Burnley. spend = 19,865 paid invoices; purchase_cards = 6,671 CEO / departmental card transactions. Empty string matches legacy records whose type was lost in older retrofits.
